{{Quote|Like I said. I ain't knowin' where this guy is. Maybe Taibela, this lady I know, might know where he is. Ask 'er.|Bosshand [[Faeto]], about [[Untas]]|<ref name="SWG:FJ" />}}
'''Taibela''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived in on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Oh! I thought my days were up. Look. I dunno where he is. Oldksam and I split from him once Faeto put out the word. And now Oldksam has gone into hiding.|Taibela, to a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]|<ref name="SWG:FJ" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Taibela resided in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] with her fiancé [[Oldksam]]. They were acquainted with the thugs [[Untas]] and [[Sleash]].<ref name="SWG:FJ" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Untas was indebted to the crime boss [[Faeto]]. When Faeto placed a [[Death mark/Legends|death mark]] on him, Oldksam, Sleash and Untas went into hiding. Taibela stayed in Mos Eisley, where she was questioned by a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. The bounty hunter convinced her to reveal that Oldksam was hiding in the [[Krayt Cult Cave]]. After that, the bounty hunter found Oldksam, then Sleash, and finally killed Untas.<ref name="SWG:FJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Taibela was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:FJ" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Taibela was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
